---
title: User Information Form
filters:
  - jlgraves-ubc/forms
form:
  action: /api/v1/user
  submit: Start the experimentation!
  method: POST
  fields:
    - name: gender
      type: radio
      id: gender
      label: Gender
      values:
        - text: Male
          value: male
        - text: Female
          value: female
        - text: Other
          value: other
        - text: Prefer not to say
          value: prefer_not_to_say
    - name: age_range
      type: radio
      id: age_range
      label: Age Range
      values:
        - text: Under 25
          value: under_25
        - text: 25 to 39
          value: from_25_to_39
        - text: 40 to 54
          value: from_40_to_54
        - text: 55 to 69
          value: from_55_to_69
        - text: Over 70
          value: over_70
        - text: Prefer not to say
          value: prefer_not_to_say
    - name: education_level
      type: radio
      id: education_level
      label: Education Level
      values:
        - text: High School Diploma
          value: high_school_diploma
        - text: Associate Degree
          value: associate_degree
        - text: Bachelor's Degree
          value: bachelor_degree
        - text: Master's Degree
          value: master_degree
        - text: Doctorate
          value: doctorate
        - text: Prefer not to say
          value: prefer_not_to_say
    - name: job_title
      type: text
      id: job_title
      label: Job Title
      required: true
    - name: specialty
      type: text
      id: specialty
      label: Specialty
    - name: data_handling_frequency
      type: radio
      id: data_handling_frequency
      label: How often do you handle data?
      values:
        - text: Never
          value: never
        - text: Rarely
          value: rarely
        - text: Sometimes
          value: sometimes
        - text: Often
          value: often
        - text: Daily
          value: daily
    - name: expertise_level
      type: radio
      id: expertise_level
      label: Expertise Level In Data Analysis
      values:
        - text: Beginner
          value: beginner
        - text: Intermediate
          value: intermediate
        - text: Expert
          value: expert
    - name: activity_type
      type: checkbox
      id: activity_type
      label: What types of activities do you engage in?
      values:
        - text: Operational Research
          value: operational_research
        - text: Decision Support
          value: decision_support
        - text: Modeling
          value: modeling
        - text: Simulation
          value: simulation
        - text: Optimization
          value: optimization
        - text: Visualization Dashboards
          value: visualization_dashboards
        - text: None of these
          value: none_of_these
        - text: Other
          value: other
    - name: data_analysis_tools
      type: checkbox
      id: data_analysis_tools
      label: What data analysis tools do you use?
      values:
        - text: Tables/Spreadsheets
          value: tables_spreadsheets
        - text: Scatter Plots
          value: scatter_plots
        - text: Heatmaps
          value: heatmaps
        - text: Parallel Coordinate Plots
          value: parallel_coordinate_plots
        - text: Other Graphical Representations
          value: other_graphical_representations
        - text: Dedicated Tools
          value: dedicated_tools
        - text: None of these
          value: none_of_these
        - text: Other
          value: other


include-before-body:
  text: |
    <style>
    form {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1em;
      }
      .form-label
      {
        font-weight: bold;
      }
      @media screen and (min-width: 900px) {
        form {
          display: flex;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          flex-direction: row;
          justify-content: space-around;
        }
        form :nth-child(4), form :nth-child(5), form br {
          width: 100%;
        }
      }
      
    </style>

---

{{< form >}}
